name: Zuri Vale Moreno
bio: Zuri lives in metro Atlanta with her wife and infant daughter, splitting her week between optimizing bus schedules, lifting at a no-frills gym, and planning little day trips that fit a strict budget. Her phone is a constant mix of YouTube rabbit holes, hip-hop interviews, runway clips, sneaker drops, and enough wrestling nostalgia to make her late to folding laundry. She likes content that feels funny, practical, or real—relationship advice, new-mom humor, wildlife conservation posts, and the occasional deep dive into UFO weirdness all make the cut. A surprising hobby of hers is restoring vintage lunchboxes she finds at flea markets, which she lines up on top of an otherwise very grown-up dining room bookshelf.

Instagram.style_description: Zuri uses Instagram as her most curated social space: a mix of cute family snapshots, gym progress, sneaker or fashion repost energy, and occasional budget-friendly day trip highlights. Her tone is playful and self-aware, with captions that lean witty, affectionate, and lightly aesthetic rather than deeply personal.

Facebook.style_description: On Facebook, Zuri is warmer, more practical, and less image-conscious. She posts milestone photos, family updates, and useful local finds, and she engages in a more straightforward way with relatives and old friends than she does on other apps.
